sources_admitted.evidence: 29 records pinned under data/sources/ai-chip-exports and data/sources/coverage with text and hash, led by the Federal Register public inspection copy of the rule; McGuire's X post was admitted from a bird read because capture cannot reach X.

derived_numbers_computed.evidence: The page computes no numbers: the 12 million TPP threshold, the 90 and 60 days, the five countries and BIS's estimate of about 100 licenses a year are printed in the rule; the 800 H100 equivalent is McGuire's conversion, attributed to him.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: NBC's 'will be banned', AP's 'took effect immediately', the Times' 'goes into effect in 90 days' and the Journal's 'new proposed rule' were each compared with the rule's review policy, DATES line, 90-day provision and ACTION line before the verdicts were written.

live_elements_guarded.evidence: The page states that the rule took effect on November 19, 2026, when the Federal Register published it (91 FR 74970), from the published document admitted that day; it carries an updated date and has no live data feed.

subject_page_updated.evidence: New subject page /events/ai-chip-exports/ with its data module, listing and three current figures from the rule: the 12 million TPP threshold, the five countries and the 90-day deadline.
